# stacklet_iac_policy_source (Resource)

Manages a Stacklet IaC policy source, a repository containing IaC policies. Deleting a policy source also deletes its policies, removing them from all policy collections.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stacklet_iac_policy_source" "example" {
  name = "example-public"
  url  = "https://github.com/example/public-repo"
}

resource "stacklet_iac_policy_source" "example_options" {
  name       = "example-options"
  url        = "https://github.com/example/policies-repo"
  branch     = "main"
  paths      = ["policies/terraform", "policies/cloudformation"]
  extensions = [".yaml"]
  auto_scan  = true
}

resource "stacklet_iac_policy_source" "example_http_auth" {
  name = "example-http-auth"
  url  = "https://github.com/example/private-repo"

  token_auth = {
    user             = "some-user"
    token_wo         = "ghp_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
    token_wo_version = "1"
  }
}

resource "stacklet_iac_policy_source" "example_ssh_auth" {
  name = "example-ssh-auth"
  url  = "ssh://git@github.com/example/private-repo"

  ssh_auth = {
    user                   = "git"
    private_key_wo         = <<EOT
-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
b3BlbnNzaC1rZXktdjEAAAAABG5vbmUAAAAEbm9uZQAAAAAAAAABAAAAMwAAAAtzc2gtZW
QyNTUxOQAAACDQSLdUuvJls2k28bLyalLCrZLaBG/ObQXBkEJl8vB1GwAAAJjX7M8q1+zP
KgAAAAtzc2gtZWQyNTUxOQAAACDQSLdUuvJls2k28bLyalLCrZLaBG/ObQXBkEJl8vB1Gw
AAAEC/dsi/DISHYy8HxIrX5JWLWhYKv2XFBlL15NLRzIlA5tBIt1S68mWzaTbxsvJqUsKt
ktoEb85tBcGQQmXy8HUbAAAADnJlcG8tdGVzdC1yYXcKAQIDBAUGBw==
-----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
EOT
    private_key_wo_version = "1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique name of the policy source.
- `url` (String) The URL of the remote repository.

### Optional

- `auto_scan` (Boolean) Whether the repository is periodically scanned for policy changes.
- `branch` (String) The branch to scan for policies. If not set, the default branch is used.
- `extensions` (Set of String) The extensions of policy files, including the leading dot.
- `paths` (Set of String) The directories to scan for policies. If not set, the whole repository is scanned.
- `ssh_auth` (Attributes) Authentication to the remote repository with an SSH key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh_auth))
- `token_auth` (Attributes) Authentication to the remote repository with a user and password or token. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--token_auth))

### Read-Only

- `webhook_url` (String) A URL which triggers scans of the remote repository.

<a id="nestedatt--ssh_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh_auth`

Required:

- `private_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The SSH private key to access the remote repository.
- `private_key_wo_version` (String) Change value to update private_key_wo.
- `user` (String) The user with access to the remote repository.

Optional:

- `passphrase_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The passphrase for the SSH private key.
- `passphrase_wo_version` (String) Change value to update passphrase_wo.


<a id="nestedatt--token_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token_auth`

Required:

- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The password or token to access the remote repository.
- `token_wo_version` (String) Change value to update token_wo.
- `user` (String) The user with access to the remote repository.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stacklet_iac_policy_source.example
  id = "$name"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import stacklet_iac_policy_source.example $name
```
